question: What role does the staff-bearing guardian play in relation to the cosmic egg and liberation?
premises: Below the cosmic egg and above Rudra is the city of the staff-bearer.
By Shiva's will he makes the cosmic egg firm.
He also makes the path of liberation possible.
inference: The staff-bearer is both a cosmic stabilizer of the egg and a guardian who enables passage on the path to liberation.
plain_english: Below the cosmic egg and above Rudra is the city of the staff-bearer. By Shiva's will he holds the egg firm and also opens the path of liberation.
